title: Mihakk case
description: One saved request that produced an indicator, stored as a regeneration recipe rather than as concrete request bytes. Credentials therefore never reach disk: they come from the session config at run time.

reproduction.description: Everything needed to regenerate the exact request. A reproduce run recomputes the request from these inputs; it does not replay stored bytes.

case_index.description: Position in the deterministic mutation sequence. The mutation for index i is a pure function of i, so worker scheduling does not affect it.

target.description: Which sample and field the mutation was applied to.

request_summary.description: A redacted, human-readable view for reports. Never a complete credentialed request.

confidence.description: Assigned by the analysis phase, not by the engine. The engine records what it observed and why; judging how much to trust it is a separate job, so this is absent on a freshly captured case.

reason.description: Why this was flagged, including the baseline it was compared against.
